BO.type: offline batch BO, greedy kriging believer with posterior-mean fantasies
BO.surrogate: GaussianProcessRegressor on log1p(Loss), ARD Matern-5/2 + bounded WhiteKernel
BO.normalization: standardized GP target; inputs frozen x,y
BO.fantasies: posterior mean; no real new FE observations
fit_warnings: The optimal value found for dimension 0 of parameter k1__k2__length_scale is close to the specified upper bound 2.0. Increasing the bound and calling fit again may find a better value.
The optimal value found for dimension 0 of parameter k2__noise_level is close to the specified lower bound 1e-08. Decreasing the bound and calling fit again may find a better value.

DE.initial_population: best valid point plus deterministic farthest-first seven from same 19; all 19 visible as historical archive
DE.first_gate: 4 of 8 trial vectors, partial generation; no parent replacement until real FE

fairness.each_branch_can_see: same frozen initial set plus own new results only
fairness.claim_limit: single seed and four first-gate evaluations per branch cannot establish statistical superiority

future_acceptance.fd_window: covers fixed 0–1.2 mm, 241 points, no extrapolation
future_acceptance.peeq: max saved frame below actual material table coverage; rejected attempts separately reviewed
future_acceptance.warning: accepted large strain, significant accepted force drop, distortion/contact anomalies require MAIN review; blocking result has null Loss
future_acceptance.attempts: failed/unknown attempt consumes one new FE budget; no automatic retry or replacement

stop_gate: Pause after first 4+4; pause earlier for identity uncertainty, incomplete output, blocking numerical warning or systemic failure
solver_permission: NONE; no queue or solver in this Run
